tower.lockedJob: PvE battle and Mystery Tower lore

originClasses.name: Wild Creature
originClasses.summary: A beast, plant, or odd animal that was not built as a copy of a person and was not posted as tower staff.
originClasses.factionRule: Optional. Leave null unless the joke truly wears one existing faction's role. A faction tag does not make it a faction member.
originClasses.not: Not an Avatar, not a Companion, not an Echo of a real person.

originClasses.name: Corrupted Echo
originClasses.summary: A tower creature that looks like a person done wrong: a badge with the wrong face, a reflection that clocked in early, a legend that copied the punchline and missed the person.
originClasses.factionRule: Optional. If it mimics one role, it may wear that faction's id. It is still not that faction's avatar and not Justin or the *_001 cast.
originClasses.not: Does not define what a player Echo hybrid Avatar is. The locked phrase stays 'Real People + Echo hybrid Avatar'. This class is only for hostile or wild research entries.

originClasses.name: Tower Guardian
originClasses.summary: Something that behaves like it works here: it takes tickets, guards a landing, or refuses to let the song end. Employment is a comedy pose, not a published org chart.
originClasses.factionRule: Optional. Guardians are tower creatures first. Do not invent a tower faction.
originClasses.not: Not proof the tower has a government. OPEN-07 still has no floor list.

originClasses.name: Tower Anomaly
originClasses.summary: A creature that is the floor misbehaving: weather with manners, a theorem that grew legs, a throne that is not sure it is final.
originClasses.factionRule: Usually null. An anomaly that settles into one role may take an optional faction id.
originClasses.not: Not a new element and not The Void. The Void remains a card pile.

originClasses.name: Faction-aligned
originClasses.summary: A creature whose silhouette and joke are about one existing faction's locked role. Use this origin only when that role is the point.
originClasses.factionRule: factionId must be FAC_AEG, FAC_PHA, FAC_CEL, or FAC_SAN. Role stays the faction's locked role. No fifth faction.
originClasses.not: Not an Avatar record, not a FAC action card, and not a statement that the faction has a canon creed.

factionRelations.name: Aegis Dominion
factionRelations.canonAnchor: Name and Tank role are canon. No creed is canon.
factionRelations.monsterRelation: Faction-aligned monsters brace, stall, or wear armor that is slightly the wrong object. They buy time. They do not rule a dominion, because no dominion is written.
factionRelations.avoid: Do not merge Sir Potlid's pot helmet into Justin Case. Do not make the faction a kingdom.

factionRelations.name: Phantom Blades
factionRelations.canonAnchor: Name and DPS role are canon. 'Phantom' is undefined.
factionRelations.monsterRelation: Faction-aligned monsters rush, nick, or arrive before the introduction finishes. 'Phantom' may be played as a comic almost-there, not as a canon species of ghost.
factionRelations.avoid: Do not revive the draft name Barry Blitz. Do not decide that the faction is undead.

factionRelations.name: Celestial Nexus
factionRelations.canonAnchor: Name and Magic role are canon. 'Science/magic comedy' is a note on Justin Theory's sample, not a school charter.
factionRelations.monsterRelation: Faction-aligned monsters mis-cast a grand effect: stars that missed the quiz, formulas that grew legs, meteor manners. Magic stays a role, not a new element wheel.
factionRelations.avoid: Do not publish a pantheon or a real-world constellation myth as this faction's doctrine.

factionRelations.name: Sanctuary Order
factionRelations.canonAnchor: Name and Support role are canon. Saving Grace is Justina Moment's locked active, not the faction's sacrament.
factionRelations.monsterRelation: Faction-aligned monsters help too hard: bandages with opinions, soup that heals and scolds, a hymn that will not let you leave until you feel better.
factionRelations.avoid: Do not revive Justin Spirit. Do not found a church. 'Sister' is part of one avatar's name only.

towerEnvironments.name: The Lobby of Lost Badges
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Cracked marble, a velvet rope, a desk lamp aimed like a spotlight, name badges in a heap.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: The tower checks everyone in under someone else's name, then acts offended.

towerEnvironments.name: The Pantry of Living Leftovers
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Copper pots, heroic steam, cutting boards used as shields, a fridge light that never blinks off.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: Dinner got ambitious and now it has opinions about being eaten.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: Any mid floor. Not a locked number.

towerEnvironments.name: The Armory of Wrong Sizes
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Racks of shields one size off, helmets that fit a mood instead of a head, dust in heroic piles.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: Every piece of armor is almost protective and completely embarrassing.
towerEnvironments.factionHint: FAC_AEG optional. The armory is not Aegis Dominion headquarters.

towerEnvironments.name: The Corridor of Uninvited Footsteps
towerEnvironments.visualMood: A carpet too long, portraits that blink late, floorboards that file a report.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: Stealth is impossible because the floor is a gossip.
towerEnvironments.factionHint: FAC_PHA optional. Do not identify the corridor with Nox Squeak.

towerEnvironments.name: The Observatory of Bad Math
towerEnvironments.visualMood: A cracked orrery, chalk constellations that disagree with the ceiling, telescopes pointed at the floor.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: The stars failed the quiz and would like a retake, loudly.
towerEnvironments.factionHint: FAC_CEL optional. Not a canon school of Justin Theory.

towerEnvironments.name: The Infirmary of Too Much Care
towerEnvironments.visualMood: White tile, glowing bandages, soup steam, a bell that rings when anyone looks tired.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: The medicine heals you and then waits for a thank-you card.
towerEnvironments.factionHint: FAC_SAN optional. Not Justina's clinic and not a church.

towerEnvironments.name: The Mirror Well
towerEnvironments.visualMood: A vertical shaft of reflections, each face half a second behind, badges that do not match the chins.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: Your reflection clocked in early and is already disappointed in you.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: Echo-heavy color. Does not explain Echo hybrid Avatars.
towerEnvironments.boundary: Use for corrupted research creatures. Do not narrate the player's hybrid as a monster.

towerEnvironments.name: The Menagerie of Unfiled Beasts
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Straw, open gates, hand-painted signs hung on the wrong cages, a ledger with paw prints in the totals.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: The filing system lost, and the animals updated their own job titles.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: Any floor. Best default home for unaffiliated beasts.

towerEnvironments.name: The Ballroom Stuck on One Dance
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Chandeliers, confetti that refuses to land, a band of armored instruments, one scuff mark worn through the floor.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: The song will not end, and neither will the bow.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: Set-piece color. Not a story gate.

towerEnvironments.name: The Basement of Retired Bosses
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Folding chairs, a throne used as a coat rack, nameplates with the title scratched into 'former'.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: Yesterday's final bosses run a support group and still enter like the world depends on it.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: Good soil for Mini Boss and Main Boss samples. They are not a canon previous game.

towerEnvironments.name: The Roof Garden of Indoor Weather
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Rain that falls only on the plants, thunder that apologizes, vines wearing tiny galoshes.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: The storm has indoor shoes and a curfew.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: High color. Not the top of the tower.

towerEnvironments.name: The Archive of Unfinished Legends
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Stacks of books with the last page torn into confetti, index cards that outrank the books, a lamp with a halo of dust.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: Every epic ends in 'to be continued' and a grocery list.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: Lore-joke color. Still not a main quest.

towerEnvironments.name: The Service Elevator Between Moods
towerEnvironments.visualMood: A flickering indicator that shows feelings instead of numbers, brass doors, a polite ding at the wrong time.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: You pressed 'ominous' and the car stopped at 'brunch'.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: Transit biome. Connects other environments without numbering them.

towerEnvironments.name: The Throne Landing of Maybe
towerEnvironments.visualMood: A door that is also a stage, one spotlight, an empty throne with a reserved sign and a second sign that says 'maybe not'.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: The final floor is not sure it is final, but it has already hired a drumroll.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: World-boss set-piece color. OPEN-07: there is no locked last floor.

towerEnvironments.name: The Gift Shop of the Conquered
towerEnvironments.visualMood: Keychains of bosses you have not met, mugs that spoil the ending, a cashier who is also a gargoyle on break.
towerEnvironments.comedyAngle: The souvenir knows the fight better than the fighter does.
towerEnvironments.sequenceHint: Secret and comedy boss color. Not the Shopping Mall (MAP-06).

attributes.schemaFact: src/schema has no element or attribute enum. These tags fill research field 12 only. They are not damage types, not weaknesses, and not new stats.

list.name: Guard
list.alignsWith: Role Tank, action DEF, faction FAC_AEG. Sample words Shield and Taunt may inspire the joke. They are not required rules.

list.name: Strike
list.alignsWith: Role DPS, action ATK, faction FAC_PHA.

list.name: Arcane
list.alignsWith: Role Magic, action Skill, faction FAC_CEL. Not an element wheel.

list.name: Aid
list.alignsWith: Role Support, faction FAC_SAN. Regen is a sample and a locked active on one avatar. This tag is not named Saving Grace.

list.name: Wild
list.alignsWith: No schema match. Flavor for ORG-WILD. Does not add a stat.

list.name: Echo
list.alignsWith: Lore look for ORG-ECHO. Not a definition of Echo hybrid Avatars and not a combat keyword.

list.name: Neutral
list.alignsWith: No faction color. Use when a role joke would over-claim.

rarityGuidance.useLadder: Avatar rarities N / R / Epic / EX (CORE-024). Monsters are creature suggestions, so they borrow the avatar ladder rather than the action ladder.
rarityGuidance.facNote: FAC is an action-card rarity (CORE-025), the same top tier as EX, and a faction play-gate. It is not a monster rank.
rarityGuidance.exNote: Nothing sits above EX. A World Boss is not a new rarity.
rarityGuidance.jokeNote: Rarity suggests how large the combat presence is. A funnier normal monster stays N.

byCategory.why: Smallest presence. Rhymes with N avatars, who are mostly base stats.
One signature trait. Rhymes with R avatars, who have Active or Passive, not both by default.
Grander than an elite, still a scene rather than a campaign. Rhymes with Epic's two skills without copying the slot rule.
A phase change rhymes with the EX Ultimate slot. Still no HP or damage numbers.
Top of the existing ladder. Do not mint a rank past EX.
Default Epic for a one-scene joke. Use EX only when the entry has a real phase transformation. Never FAC.

siblingWatch.note: Samples are linked in sample_lore_links.json. Style-guide tensions from ee9c649 closed at b7132e2. Entry-level flags are in the link file and are not canon edits.
siblingWatch.yield: Agent 06's guide uses ORG-* ids, ATTR-* ids, ENV-TWR-01..15, and Normal N / Elite R. The 30 links keep those ids.

flagWhen: A fifth faction or a renamed faction appears
Justin Spirit, Barry Blitz, Valhalla, or Sync is used as current lore
A Justin is written as the same person as the matching *_001 avatar
Rarity is Common, Rare, Legendary, Mythic, or FAC
The Void is a place or an element
The entry requires a main story
A protected proper name from another work is used as the creature's name
The hook defines how Echo Summoning works
